board.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-RS485-CAN
board.notes: ESP32-S3R8 module, 16 MB flash. PSRAM is not initialised by this firmware, so no GPIO is lost to it.

ports.name: CAN FD add-on
ports.notes: Header only, no controller fitted from the factory. Enable after wiring an MCP2518FD breakout.

ports.name: RS485
ports.notes: SP3485 with DE and /RE tied together on GPIO21.

ports.name: HIA4V1 precharge control
ports.notes: Reuses the primary contactor pins, so it replaces contactor_control rather than running alongside it.

ports.name: SMA inverter contactor enable
ports.notes: Shares GPIO9 with battery_wakeup wup2; only one of the two can be enabled.

ports.name: Battery wake-up
ports.notes: wup1 collides with the second battery contactor output and wup2 with the SMA enable input. Enable only for a battery that needs wake-up, and disable the two ports it displaces.

ports.name: SSD1306-compatible I2C display
ports.notes: Alternative to statusled: SCL shares GPIO2, so enable one or the other, never both.
